title: Preparation
subtitle: The setup and preparation stage
summary: We install what you need, open the accounts, and set up the environment we will use throughout the praktikum.

prep.intro: The first lesson is {sana}. Have this list ready by then. It takes about 30 minutes in all, and it means we start working straight away in class.

items.title: A computer
items.note: A macOS or Windows laptop where you can install programs. A phone or tablet is not enough.
steps: Bring your own laptop to the lessons. The whole practicum is hands-on.
Check that you have admin rights: you need to install programs. If it is a work computer, ask your IT team.
Keep at least 5 GB of free disk space.

items.title: A Google account
items.note: NotebookLM, Gemini and Google Sheets open through this account. If you already have one, you do not need a new one.
steps: Enter your first name, last name and a new email address.
Confirm your phone number. A code arrives by SMS.
Write the password down: you will need it in class.

items.title: Claude subscription
items.note: The main tool of the practicum. You need at least the Pro plan, and we recommend Max from Lesson 02.
steps: Go to claude.ai and sign up with "Continue with Google".
In Settings → Billing choose the Pro plan. It costs $20 a month.
Pay with an international Visa or Mastercard. The card needs a dollar balance and online payments switched on. Uzcard and Humo do not work.
Install the Claude app from claude.ai/download and sign in with the same account.
items.footnote: From Lesson 02 you use Claude Code a lot, and the Pro limit can run out fast. Then switch to Max (from $100 a month).

items.title: Warp and Claude Code
items.note: Claude Code runs in the Warp terminal. Install it and open it once.
steps: Download Warp from warp.dev and install it.
Type claude and press Enter. A browser opens: sign in with your Claude account.
If Claude Code answers your greeting, you are ready.
items.footnote: If the install fails, send a screenshot of the error to your mentor. Mentors help at the end of Lesson 01.
